name: Kiban Structural
description: Kiban Structural is a calm, high-contrast WordPress theme designed for structural engineering practices and technical studios. Built with an eight-column construction grid, low-key monochrome styling, and sticky-media project timelines, it presents calculations, drawings, and built works with quiet authority.
